items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

ctx.x: Yeah. When Captain Braun had the contract for years and years, played. Then... Benny Moss. Benny Moss. Benny Moss got it. Yeah. I played. And some other fella got it. Nice-hazard guy got it.
Ooh, who are these things for filth?
